reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Upgrade providers: Upgrade your providers to versions that support both namespaced and cluster-scoped managed resources: Update your provider manifests to use…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Provider manifests must be updated to v2 versions (e.g., xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/provider-aws-s3:v2.0.0) to ensure compatibility with Crossplane v2.0.0 and support for both legacy cluster-scoped and new namespaced managed resources.

proposed.statement: Provider manifests must be upgraded to v2 versions to support both namespaced and cluster-scoped managed resources in Crossplane v2.0.0.
